name: Nimble Whip
body:
Source Dirty Tactics Toolbox pg. 25
Aura faint transmutation CL 3rd
Slot none; Price 5,005 gp; Weight 2 lbs.
Description
On a successful critical hit with this +1 scorpion whip (Pathfinder RPG Ultimate Combat 145), the wielder can attempt a steal combat maneuver (Pathfinder RPG Advanced Player’s Guide 322) against the target as a swift action as if she had the Improved Steal (Advanced Player’s Guide 163) feat.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, mage hand; Price 2,655 gp
